name: Const
comment: Various constant values for enumerations and calculations.

variables.name: bottom
variables.comment: Represents bottom position or direction

variables.name: bottom_left
variables.comment: Represents bottom left position or direction

variables.name: bottom_right
variables.comment: Represents bottom right position or direction

variables.name: deg_to_rad
variables.comment: Multiply this constant with a degree to get a radian

variables.name: epsilon
variables.comment: Represents an arbitrary very small number. It is set as 0.0001 here.

variables.name: gaussian
variables.comment: Gaussian constant (1 / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI))

variables.name: gravity
variables.comment: Gravity acceleration (unit: m/s^2) and gravity force (unit: Newton) on 1kg of mass.

variables.name: half_pi
variables.comment: Half π radian (90deg)

variables.name: horizontal
variables.comment: Represents horizontal direction.

variables.name: identical
variables.comment: Represents identical point or value

variables.name: left
variables.comment: Represents left position or direction

variables.name: max
variables.comment: Represents Number.MAX_VALUE. Note: as a Float32 Pt value this overflows to Infinity.

variables.name: min
variables.comment: Represents Number.MIN_VALUE, the smallest *positive* number (5e-324) — not the most negative number. Do not use it to initialize a running maximum; use -Infinity instead. As a Float32 Pt value this flushes to 0.

variables.name: newton
variables.comment: 1 Newton: 0.10197 Kilogram-force

variables.name: one_degree
variables.comment: π/180 or 1 degree in radian

variables.name: pi
variables.comment: π radian (180 deg)

variables.name: quarter_pi
variables.comment: π/4 radian (45deg)

variables.name: rad_to_deg
variables.comment: Multiply this constant with a radian to get a degree

variables.name: right
variables.comment: Represents right position or direction

variables.name: top
variables.comment: Represents top position or direction

variables.name: top_left
variables.comment: Represents top left position or direction

variables.name: top_right
variables.comment: Represents top right position or direction

variables.name: two_pi
variables.comment: Two π radian (360deg)

variables.name: vertical
variables.comment: Represents vertical direction.

variables.name: xy
variables.comment: A string to indicate xy plane.

variables.name: xyz
variables.comment: A string to indicate xyz space.

variables.name: xz
variables.comment: A string to indicate xz plane.

variables.name: yz
variables.comment: A string to indicate yz plane.
